column1: # Isaac can buy bread for Altin.

column3:
Please, warriors, the rain
ruined our grain and twelve
families are going hungry.{page_break}Could you spare 250 coins
for some bread?{end_now}
The children are eating\nbecause of you. Go well.{end_wait}
No coins to spare? Neither\ndo we. Go well, warrior.{end_wait}
It isn't much. Tell them to\neat.{end_wait}
